source: SIGLO database (LXCat, Chen ref 22): sum of the 2P+2S+3D+3P levels — the higher 2p/2s-3d/3p manifolds (Ne**). Previously only the first level of each manifold was used, discarding ~half the 96%-bath excitation sink (EEDF inelastic wall + Ne* stepwise pool).
comment: (2p) extrapolated after 88 eV using ln(energy)energy**2. SIGLO dataset (Chen 2025, ref 22); re-sourced from crossbrowser lxcat_siglo.json, source id SIGLO__Ne__Excitation__28. Representative level: Ne 2P (higher excited) taken as the lumped Ne** (arf.toml R2). Cross section stored in m^2 by SIGLO (converted to cm^2 for the CSV column).
